llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Details screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Details screen is defined as DetailsScreen and registered in the stack navigator under the 'Details' key.
evidence: Stack = createNativeStackNavigator({ screens: { Details: { screen: DetailsScreen } } })

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must update header title from `useLayoutEffect` to avoid flicker on initial render.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Header title is updated via useEffect, not useLayoutEffect. useEffect runs after paint, causing a visible flicker on initial render.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Navigator is constructed with createNativeStackNavigator (static API) and rendered via createStaticNavigation(Stack).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set the stack header title in screen logic via `setOptions`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: DetailsScreen calls navigation.setOptions({ title: name }) to dynamically set the header title at runtime.
